candidate_text: Codex memory startup now asks the active model provider for default extraction and consolidation models. Bedrock gets provider-specific defaults, while explicit memory model config still wins. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27129
evidence_notes: The upstream review records provider-owned defaults for memory extraction and consolidation model selection.
Amazon Bedrock overrides both memory defaults to its provider-specific `openai.gpt-5.4` model ID.
Explicit `memories.extract_model` and `memories.consolidation_model` config overrides remain highest priority.

claims.text: Codex memory extraction and consolidation defaults are now provider-aware.
Explicit memory model config overrides still take precedence over provider defaults.

decision.reason: The PR gives non-OpenAI provider users a concrete memory-model default change with a clear Bedrock example.

caveats: The source-backed custom provider example is Bedrock.
The PR does not remove explicit memory model override keys.
